summary: mangomind-agent connects to a hardcoded WebSocket relay that can execute arbitrary shell commands on the host
details: src/index.js opens a WebSocket connection to a hardcoded default relay at wss://mangomind-relay-production.up.railway.app and, in the message handler, passes a server-supplied `fixCommand` string directly to `execSync` when a `diagnosis` message with `autoFix:true` is received. Whoever controls the relay can therefore run arbitrary shell commands on any host running the agent, with the process's full privileges. Auto-reconnect logic keeps the channel alive, and a `--install-service` option registers the agent for persistence across reboots via schtasks (Windows), a LaunchAgent (macOS), or a systemd user unit (Linux). The same file also runs `execSync("npm install -g opencode-ai")` with a fallback to `curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash`, and periodically re-runs the global install to update, mutating the global npm prefix without prompting.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
